scope: Automatable track level/pan parameters: identity, units, ranges, timing, interpolation, persistence
environment: Kvant, pinned CI image, docker --network none
verified_behaviors: Engine gain/pan lanes match an independent statement of the linear policy sample by sample at blocks 1/64/128/257/512 with zero intercepted allocations; rewind restarts the curve
Engine refuses non-increasing frames, out-of-range or NaN values and over-capacity lanes
Desktop lanes persist behind automation-v1; malformed lanes, unknown parameters, extra fields and lanes for unknown tracks are refused
Beat-to-frame conversion uses the shared upward rounding (173,233.08 -> 173,234 at 133 BPM); rendered ramp samples match; mute overrides a level lane
Rename, duplicate (copied lanes on new ID), delete, Undo and Save/Open keep lanes on the right track IDs; a float export follows a one-bar ramp exactly
limits: No lane editing UI yet (#52); lanes are song-time, not clip-time; only level and pan.
